acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in “top-15” data-dependent mode
alkylation reagent: peptides with a minimum length of seven amino amino acids with carbamidomethylation as a fixed modification
cleavage agent: overnight digestion by adding Lys-C and trypsin in a 1:50 ratio
collision energy: Following higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27%
fractionation method: concatenated into 8 fractions by high-pH reversed-phase fractionation using the recently described “loss-less” nano-fractionator
fragmentation method: Following higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27%
instrument: conducted on a quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive HF, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL, USA)
ionization type: coupled to an EASYnLC 1200 ultra-high-pressure system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) via a nano-electrospray ion source
labeling: The resulting 400 samples were analyzed with a state-of-the-art label-free workflow
